summary: Complete end-to-end testing of ContainerLogix system completed successfully. All backend APIs working perfectly (17/17 tests passed). Frontend fully functional with user registration/login, dashboard statistics, CRUD operations for drivers/companies/movements, filtering, reports generation, and responsive mobile design.

design_issues.issue: Form data does not persist across page navigation - no explicit auto-save implementation found
design_issues.note: This appears to be expected behavior as there's no backend session storage or local storage auto-save implementation
